settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Upload a square image (at least 32x32px). PNG or SVG. Used for the browser tab icon and home-screen icon on mobile.

settings.label: Logo (for search engines)
settings.info: Square or wide logo, at least 512px. Used in Organization structured data and as the last-resort social share image. Not shown on the storefront.

settings.label: Business name
settings.info: Leave blank to use the store name.

settings.label: Business description
settings.info: One or two sentences describing the business. Used in Organization structured data.

settings.label: Homepage title suffix
settings.info: Added after the store name in the browser title, e.g. "THE EDIT | Original Imported Skincare in Pakistan". Keep the whole title under 60 characters. An SEO title set in Online Store > Preferences overrides this.

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.info: Under 155 characters. Used when no description is set in Online Store > Preferences.
settings.default: Original skincare in Pakistan: pharmacy-sourced CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, ISDIN and Avene, plus CHAM as official partner. Sealed, batch codes intact.

settings.label: Default social share image
settings.info: Shown when a page with no image of its own is shared on WhatsApp, Facebook or X. 1200x630px works best.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification code
settings.info: The content value of the google-site-verification meta tag. Leave blank if Search Console is verified by DNS or Google Analytics.

settings.label: Area served
settings.info: Country code of the market you sell to.

settings.label: YouTube URL
settings.info: The store's own channel only. Do not use a supplier's or brand's channel here.
